Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J.
1.

Vakalatnama has been filed today by Sri Hari Keshav Singh, Advocate on behalf of opposite party
No.2, is taken on record.

2. Heard Sri Shailendra Kumar Rai, learned counsel for the applicants, Sri Hari Keshav Singh,
learned counsel for opposite party No.2 and learned A.G.A. for the State.

3. The present 482 Cr.P.C. application has been filed to quash the entire proceedings of Case No.351 of 2021, arising out of Case Crime No.132 of 2021, under Sections-498A, 506, 406 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of DP Act, Police Station-Mahila Thana, District- Ghaziabad, pending in the court of Civil Judge Aryaman Gupta And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/196771377/
1 (JD)/FTC-I, Ghaziabad.
4.

entities.label: STATUTE

entities.text: Civil Judge Aryaman Gupta And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicants submits that the parties have reconciled their differences and compromise have entered between them which has been reduced in writing.
Applicant No.1 is husband of opposite party No.2.
Compromise deed has been filed as annexure 7 to the affidavit.
5. Learned counsel appearing for the opposite party no. 2 does not dispute the correctness of the facts.
6. Accordingly, it is provided that the parties shall appear before the court below along with a certified copy of this order on the next date fixed.

It is therefore expected that the trial court may fix a date for the verification of the compromise entered into between the parties and pass an appropriate order to that effect within next four weeks.

It shall be open to the applicants to file a fresh application U/S 482 at that stage for the relief sought herein.
7.
In view of the above, the present application is disposed of.
8. For a period of five weeks, no coercive measure shall be taken against the applicants.

Order Date :- 16.12.2023 Nitin Verma  Aryaman Gupta And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/196771377/
